summary: Read bank transfer receipts an owner shares in the assistant chat (photo or PDF) with OpenAI, then match them to an owing order, a transfer between the business's own accounts, or money out, and draft the existing reviewed action. Nothing is recorded until the owner confirms.

capabilities.note: Receipts in chat draft this existing action with the receiving account, the receipt facts in its note and an optional receiptAttachmentId; on confirm the receipt joins the order's Notes & photos through the existing order_attachment_add executor. Roles, procedure, review lines and rollout are unchanged.

docs.note: Receipts draft existing actions (payment_record, money_transfer_simple, expense_record_simple, money_movement, sale_record, customer_receipt) through their existing permission checks and reviews. No capability is added or released.

evidence.result: 6 tests, 20 assertions pass: amount parsing, reference normalization, strict parsing, model allowlist, PDF as file input with usage, provider failure.
15 tests, 34 assertions pass: names, masked account numbers, own transfer, money out purpose, order match by number/remark/sender/typed name, part and excess payment, unknown account, unreadable.

Guarded development QA (ewatrade_qa_v1, own QA business, removed after): receipt matched to the owing order by sender, payment confirmed and the receipt kept on the order, duplicate reference refused, unknown sender asked then matched by typed name, own-account transfer, money-out expense, purpose question, unknown account, not-a-receipt and unreadable. Provider read synthetic. 1 test, 20 assertions pass.
Media turn and channel proposal review suites: 14 tests, 98 assertions pass with the inert database URL.
